summary: Better Living TV Theater was an early American television documentary series that aired from 1953 to 1954. It was first broadcast on ABC as a Sunday afternoon summer replacement, with its final ABC broadcast on August 16, 1953, and later aired on the DuMont Television Network. The series was moderated by Fischer Black.
one_line: Better Living TV Theater was a 1953-1954 American documentary series moderated by Fischer Black, aired on ABC and later DuMont.
key_facts: Better Living TV Theater was an early American television program.
The program was originally broadcast on ABC.
The program was later broadcast on the DuMont Television Network, which the note describes as now defunct.
Better Living TV Theater was a documentary series.
The documentary series featured moderator Fischer Black.
The ABC version was a summer replacement series.
The ABC version aired on Sunday afternoons.
The final ABC broadcast of Better Living TV Theater occurred on August 16, 1953.
